protocol.reason: Compare the observed launch path using only native CUDA Graph size selection. With S64 the native default captures up to 128 tokens; an append-only tool observation can exceed this even when a large history prefix is reused. Mixed batches then cannot use those captured graphs. Wider piecewise graphs may reduce host launches but can pad more compute and require more memory/startup time.

decision.scope: A targeted native-graph coverage screen, not final configuration adoption. Raw stage material must be retrieved and verified before its GPU work starts.
decision.finding: In matched 15-second native windows, C64 has 1053 complete forward spans, with 27.3504% no-Graph paths; C96 has 615 spans, with 57.5610% no-Graph paths. Mean host duration of those paths is 28.5510 versus 28.3295 ms. GPU activity interval union is 7.21385 versus 4.96461 seconds. Prefix behavior and model requests remain real.
decision.source_evidence: Active S64 service captures through 128 tokens. Native dispatcher returns NONE above its maximum captured size. FULL_AND_PIECEWISE is active, and the GDN backend supports UNIFORM_BATCH, not arbitrary full mixed batches.
decision.inference_limit: These traces identify launch paths but do not record each scheduler batch token count. The graph-size guard is a plausible cause to test, not an already proven explanation of every no-Graph span. Runtime/driver API records can nest; API counts are not unique kernel executions.
decision.experiment: Compare native default G128 with G1024 and G4096, keeping the existing decode sizes, S64/B8192/API1/P32, APC align, model, budgets and real tools. Measure C64 and C96 with paired controls. No Nsight, NVTX or trajectory export in these six runs.
decision.quality: The original strict per-task gates are unchanged. The C64 plain profiling control had an extra safety error round; do not label it qualified or count any profiling case as an independent formal repeat.

protocol.control: G128 exactly reproduces the S64 native default capture-size list. Same production source and no Nsight, NVTX or full trace export in all six cases. Each case has a fresh engine; all five actual tasks and real tools are retained.
protocol.graph_mode: FULL_AND_PIECEWISE remains unchanged. Do not request unsupported full mixed GDN capture or override native support checks.
protocol.budgets: Same seed 20260904, engine seed 0, temperature 0, top_p 1, top_k 20; eight rounds, 2048 generated-token limit, 12000 chars/160 bounded-context lines.
protocol.gate: Original frozen task-level minimum effective rate, quality and F1, maximum tool/output/cost metrics; all failures retained, actual requests equal actual turns. One diagnostic is not repeatability or final acceptance.
protocol.further_candidates: A lower batch-token budget coordinated with the captured range is considered only after inspecting these results; do not launch an unbounded parameter sweep.

same_load_screen_comparisons.interpretation: One independent engine per case, single screen only. No repeat variance or confidence interval. Failed quality gates prevent adoption.

remaining: Quality-qualified candidate, three independent formal comparisons, paced load, 15-minute steady test, seven frozen independent tasks, final real-model MCP/SkyRL/cache acceptance and retrieval before shutdown.
